why: Fix round (one agent, 0177) for slice S1 of docs/plan/quests/port-scripts-0113-PLAN.md, the lint hold on 0113, on branch fabrikalfa/port-0113-s01 from bad5a82, after the review sent eb4fa6e back: after env, the hold skipped flags and NAME=value words but not the value an option takes, so '#!/usr/bin/env -S -u FOO bash' and '#!/usr/bin/env -S -C /tmp sh' passed. oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.ts now skips the word after an env option that takes one (GNU coreutils env's -u/--unset, -C/--chdir, -a/--argv0; BSD env's -u, -C, -P, -L, -U; a short one may end a flag cluster such as -iu), citing both man pages in a comment; the --unset=NAME forms stay one word. The extensionless law's generators in oxlint-plugins/tracked-scripts.test.ts now draw up to three env words before the interpreter, of three kinds (NAME=value, plain flags, options with their value, whose value may be a shell's name), for both the shell and the non-shell side, and the law fails if a kind is never drawn. It was red on the hold at eb4fa6e: '#!/usr/bin/env -u python3 node' read python3 as the interpreter and gave an extra finding; '#!/usr/bin/env -S -u FOO bash' gave no finding there, checked by calling check directly. The pinned law's plant comment says a 20th entry and the 19, and the plan's Laws row adds '(plus the three tsh launchers, lead ruling 2026-11-16)'. Every law's title and assertions are kept.
